verdict.rationale: Defining infrastructure in a general-purpose language is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Terraform using "human-readable configuration files". Nothing in the pack documents support for a general-purpose programming language with types, loops, and IDE tooling. Community comments criticize the configuration language as "half-baked" and favor Pulumi on this front, which supports the absence of this capability.
